slides.title: CEMENTO
slides.subtitle: Bridging International Academies & Seoul's Production Infrastructure
slides.keyNote: Co-founded by Yvannoé Kruger (Ex-POUSH) × Kyeongnan Kim (CEO, D_RECTUS)

slides.title: Beyond the Ephemeral: From Temporary Fairs to Long-Term Infrastructure
slides.lead: The contemporary global art circuit is paralyzed by transient pop-up exhibitions and prohibitive fabrication costs. Asian artists in Europe remain structurally excluded from monumental production capabilities.

items.detail: Ephemeral commercial exposure without sustainable production base or deep institutional integration in European capitals.
Prohibitive studio rental and material fabrication costs in Europe, reducing ambitious concepts to small-scale transportable objects.
Total isolation of Asian creative diaspora from historic national academies (Villa Médicis, American Academy, Villa Massimo).
A permanent physical footing at Via Casilina in Rome, operating as an unshakeable institutional bridgehead for 2+ decades.
Shared community-scale fabrication floor (metal, timber, heavy casting, 3D additive tech) dismantling fabrication barriers.
Direct institutional gateway interfacing Korean fellows with Rome's elite academy constellation and vice versa in Seoul.

slides.title: The Machine Hall & The Integrated Community
slides.lead: Located in Pigneto, Rome's dynamic creative core, CEMENTO repurposes a former industrial automobile icon into a collaborative production ecosystem.

cards.title: Former Lancia/Fiat Site
cards.desc: Secured 21-year tenure in Pigneto. Raw concrete spans, high-clearance overhead cranes, and natural sawtooth clerestory illumination built for heavy material manipulation and immersive installations.

cards.title: Heavy Production Floor
cards.desc: Equipped with industrial CNC milling, robotic arm welding, precision woodworking, large-volume 3D additive printing, and digital fabrication stations operated under a shared resource-pooling ethos.

cards.title: Institutional Constellation
cards.desc: Direct diplomatic and production workspace nexus with Rome's legendary cultural institutes: Villa Médicis (France), Circolo Scandinavo (Nordic), Villa Massimo (Germany), and the American Academy in Rome.

slides.title: Not Just Another Residency. A Self-Sustaining Atelier of Freedom.
slides.lead: A hybrid public-private venue built on industrial or transport idle land (KORAIL/KTX assets or municipal brownfields), replicating the raw production autonomy in the heart of East Asia.

quadrants.label: 50:50 COHORT DIVERSITY
quadrants.heading: Reciprocal Fellowships
quadrants.detail: Strict balance of 50% Korean innovative practitioners and 50% International fellows from Rome's academies, sparking constant cross-continental friction.

quadrants.label: 24/7 UNRESTRICTED ACCESS
quadrants.heading: Production Sovereignty
quadrants.detail: Round-the-clock atelier and workshop access. Unconstrained operating hours designed for intense conceptualization, casting, and digital fabrication runs.

quadrants.label: INDUSTRIAL REDEVELOPMENT
quadrants.heading: Brownfield Activation
quadrants.detail: Strategic repurposing of urban transport infrastructure (underutilized rail yards, logistics depots) creating massive civic and artistic value.

quadrants.label: FINANCIAL CIRCULARITY
quadrants.heading: Self-Sustaining Model
quadrants.detail: Integrated commercial F&B, flagship design retail, and private fashion/tech brand event revenue streams subsidizing artist production grants directly.

slides.title: Value Proposition for Public Institutions & Corporate Partners
slides.lead: A tailored dual-track architecture delivering measurable cultural diplomacy for governments and high-yield placemaking for forward-thinking enterprises.

tracks.partnerScope: MCST / ARKO / KAMS / ITALIAN EMBASSY / EUNIC

deliverables.title: First Permanent Korean Footprint in Rome's Elite Academy Circuit
deliverables.text: Breaking past isolated bilateral exhibitions to establish a permanent national creative base alongside Villa Médicis and Villa Massimo.

deliverables.title: Reciprocal Bilateral Fellowship Architecture
deliverables.text: Formalized residency exchange channels channeling European master creators into Korea's manufacturing ecosystem and vice-versa.

deliverables.title: High-Efficiency Public Fund Deployment
deliverables.text: Leveraging existing industrial infrastructure to yield 4x public grant impact compared to one-off exhibition rentals.

tracks.partnerScope: ESG FUNDS / MOBILITY / REAL ESTATE DEVELOPERS

deliverables.title: Idle Urban Space Activation
deliverables.text: Transforming dormant industrial/transit parcels into high-density global creative capital with massive civic goodwill.

deliverables.title: Authentic ESG & Cultural Brand Association
deliverables.text: Direct partnership with pioneering European-Asian creative production, positioning sponsors as patrons of genuine cultural infrastructure.

deliverables.title: Commercial Cross-Synergy
deliverables.text: Priority access to venue spaces for tier-1 brand presentations, design weeks, cutting-edge material R&D, and collector previews.

slides.title: Equitable In-Kind Structure & Curatorial Autonomy
slides.lead: Symmetric resource balancing eliminates cash drain between hubs, while ironclad curatorial co-direction preserves total institutional integrity.

pillars.label: IN-KIND HOST PRINCIPLE
pillars.desc: The Seoul hub provides living quarters, studio space, fabrication machines, and local public relations for Rome fellows. In mirror reciprocity, CEMENTO Rome provides equivalent raw facilities and academy access for Korean fellows.

pillars.label: LOGISTICS & MOBILITY
pillars.desc: Airfares, living stipends, and shipping costs are underwritten by sending nations' cultural bodies (ARKO, KAMS, Institut Français, Goethe-Institut), creating zero international cross-debt.

pillars.label: GOVERNANCE & CURATION
pillars.desc: Independent selection committees in Seoul and Rome. Equal co-chairmanship: Yvannoé Kruger (Rome operations & European networks) and Kyeongnan Kim (Seoul satellite & Asian production networks) with mandatory co-crediting.

slides.title: Phased Execution (2026 — 2027)
slides.lead: A disciplined, step-function deployment ensuring legal anchor validation, academy cohort onboarding, and satellite scaling.
